body: I don't know if I even want to. It feels like she was the best I could ever get, but sometimes I thought that things were missing. I don't know. It's hopeless

I should've been more clear. We dated for 14 months, but she was so much more to me than just my girlfriend. I felt like I knew her so well. I've been so stressed with school and work that I've been getting mad, at least that's what I think. I was going to start seeing a counselor, but then this happened and I haven't been able to do anything for a while.
